title: The Product Passport Becomes the House Record
author: RN Collins
rightsRule: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

carouselA.title: The Product Passport Becomes the House Record: the institutional sequence

frames.caption: A product passport can become part of a house archive when verified compliance data is joined to provenance, care, repair, change, authorship, and stewardship without confusing mandatory fields with complete history.
frames.alt: Title plate for The Product Passport Becomes the House Record.
frames.treatment: typography, rule, folio and domain color only

frames.caption: The ensemble carries material decisions across components; the surviving object cannot narrate every demonstration, correction, and embodied judgment that produced them.

frames.alt: House of Worth ensemble from 1893 in dark silk with jet and metal ornament, shown frontally.

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 01 · REQUIRE — What is legally required now?. Identify product scope, applicable delegated acts, actor, territory, date, required fields, carrier, access rules, and official legal source. Mark future implementation unresolved until adopted.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what is legally required now? within The Product Passport Becomes the House Record.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 02 · VERIFY — Who supports each field?. Bind claim, data source, responsible party, verification method, date, confidence, correction, and evidence file. Do not transform a supplier assertion into an audited fact.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping who supports each field? within The Product Passport Becomes the House Record.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 03 · EXTEND — What history may responsibly be added?. Connect design development, maker and repair records, care, alterations, provenance, archive deposit, rights, and permitted owner narration while minimizing personal data.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what history may responsibly be added? within The Product Passport Becomes the House Record.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 04 · PRESERVE — Will the record survive the vendor?. Require export, open formats, persistent identifiers, versioning, backups, access governance, migration tests, and a non-digital fallback for essential care information.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping will the record survive the vendor? within The Product Passport Becomes the House Record.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.caption: More product data does not automatically create accountability. A passport can amplify unverified claims, expose workers or consumers, shift burdens onto suppliers, and become inaccessible after sale. Evidence quality and governance matter more than interface polish.
frames.alt: Counterpoint card for The Product Passport Becomes the House Record.
frames.treatment: typographic quotation field; no decorative imagery

frames.caption: Trace every proposed field to its source and verifier.
